title: dmg-quito-final: analysis code for 'Gestational diabetes mellitus detected under routine risk-based screening in Quito, Ecuador'
description:
R code for a prospective cohort study of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in 523 pregnant women in Quito, Ecuador (2021–2023). It estimates GDM cumulative incidence under the recorded diagnosis and a restricted operational definition, factors associated with GDM, and maternal and neonatal outcomes.

Individual-level data are not included, under approval CEISH-UCE 017-CEISH.UCE.2021 and Ecuador's Organic Law on Personal Data Protection. They are available upon reasonable request to the corresponding author (ptoapanta@uce.edu.ec).
